title: Episode 4 (lines 753–883)

teacherSummary.text: Antigone is led toward her living tomb. She laments that she dies unwed and unmourned, compares herself to Niobe, and argues that a brother, once both parents are dead, can never be replaced. The Chorus both pities and blames her. Creon orders the guards to take her away.
